This charge included a one-time lease termination payment of $7.6 million, a write-off related to remaining leasehold improvements and furniture and equipment of $2.6 million, and estimated miscellaneous expenses associated with exiting the property of $0.2 million. We also recognized a related lease termination gain pertaining to the elimination of the lease liability, net of an associated right-of-use asset (ROU asset) of $1.0 million, which was included in Other expenses on our Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income (Loss). The decision to terminate the former Reno operating lease was undertaken as part of an ongoing review of our facility needs.
